speaker: john_heminges
text: The afternoon is off the stage. You were in it, Will. The book is open for the week. It is not open for Monday's question.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Monday stays shut. If the Christmas column is blank, it stays blank. I have not come to write a sum under a hope.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is blank. This week's matter is a share. Thirty-eight shillings. Your part, of the company, for the week to today.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thirty-eight is a clean figure. Say share, and have done. Thou art not required to divide it into a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A share. I will write thirty-eight shillings. I will not write a coffer under them.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You may write it. I have heard enough about shoes for one week, and I am not walking the speech back to Richmond to see if it has grown a purse.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Thirty-eight. The fourth of October was a better week, and it was a different week. I will not make this one apologise to that one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. That Saturday was forty-five. This Saturday is thirty-eight. They are neighbours, not a quarrel.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Wednesday's eightpence is already entered, under the copying. We are not agreeing it again. We are not building this share by taking it off a total we never stated.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The eightpence stands. The hired men stand at their ten shillings, as the book already has them. Neither of those is a new sum at this table.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And Christmas is not in this column. I stood with John on Monday. I am not standing up to repeat the speech in order to feel resolute.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The blank stays a blank. What we set for the days ahead is the work that belongs here.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tuesday, the Shrew. You are not in it, Will. The king stands Thursday week, which we had already from Wednesday. I am not naming a man to wear Tuesday's coat. The coat can wait for a man without a christening at my book.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wilt have Tuesday morning, then. Do not spend the rest of this reckoning telling us the page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not. A house finds a girl asleep. It is not a tomb. It is not a new play. You will get no leaf of it tonight.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A man who says he will not, and then does not, is a man I can walk home beside. I am for home. The purse can be heavy there as well as here.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Home is the better house. I will not drink thirty-eight shillings before they are in the purse. Drinking a figure is how a figure becomes a story.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick is not a line in this book. The mornings I asked for have not begun. Nobody is to price them, and nobody is to report them as done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody will. He spoke what he spoke. The rest is not a share, and it is not a sum, and it is not a lesson already given.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then thirty-eight is the news. The six pound we named on Monday is still only the stock we named. I will not hear it turned into a balance to make the share look earned.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It is not a balance. Thirty-eight shillings, a share. I have said share. I have not said a word that slices the company into a fraction for the pleasure of the arithmetic.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will enter it at home as received. Expected stays expected, with no figure beside it. The two lines will not be married into one total.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You and your two lines. Write them, and leave me out of the moral. I am satisfied. That is the whole of my speech.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Satisfied is enough. Thou hast the figure. Walk it home. A week with a blank in it does not need a celebration to make it true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am walking it home. The lodging has the book. The book can bear thirty-eight shillings without an audience.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And without the old days. I spent those on Monday. They can sit the week out.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Let them sit. I will see the boxes shut, and then I have finished.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Shut, and entered. Thirty-eight. The blank left blank. Tuesday without you. That is the reckoning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the reckoning. A short walk to all of you, and no second meeting on the way.
